subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should Feishu multi-bot @mention admission proceed with a proven union_id-style identity, a cross-app open_id mapping strategy, or a broader Feishu multi-bot identity design?
rationale: The submitted union_id source is contradicted by the linked issue and closed sibling PR, and the choice affects message admission for existing Feishu multi-bot group setups.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Design
options.body: Keep this as investigation context while a broader Feishu multi-bot identity PR resolves mention identity, bot-to-bot visibility, and session scope together.

options.title: Document Current Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable cross-app bot identity, document the supported workaround instead of landing a partial fallback.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already requested changes on this exact Feishu identity decision surface.
